question:
If x + y + z = 19, xy + yz + zx = 114, then the value of \(\sqrt{x^3+y^3-3xyz}\) is:
(CGL 2018 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is Option 3 i.e. 19.

x + y + z = 19 
xy + yz + zx = 114 
When there are two equations and 3 variables, then we can assume 1 variable is zero 
Let, z = 0 
x + y = 19 
xy = 114 
⇒ \(\sqrt{x^3+y^3-3xyz}\) = \(\sqrt{x^3+y^3}\)

⇒ \(\sqrt{x^3+y^3}\) = \(\sqrt{(x+y)(x^2+y^2-xy})\)

⇒ \(\sqrt{(x+y)[(x+y)^2-3xy]}\)

⇒ \(\sqrt{(19)[361-342]}\) = 19

question:

(CGL 2018 Pre)

question:
If (3x - 1)3 + (4x - 3)3 + (2x + 1)3 = 3(3x - 7)(4x - 3)(2x + 1) and x ≠ \(1\over3\), then x = ?
(CGL 2018 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is Option 3 i.e. 2.

(3x - 1)3 + (4x - 3)3 + (2x + 1)3 = 3(3x - 7)(4x - 3)(2x + 1) 
As we know:-
If a3 + b3 + c3 = 3abc, then a + b + c = 0 
but x ≠ 1/3 
So using this 
⇒ 3x - 1 = 4x - 3 = 2x + 1
⇒ 3x - 1 = 4x - 3
⇒ 4x - 3x = 3 - 1
⇒ x = 2

question:

question:

x3 + y3 + z3 - 3xyz = 18 × 54 = 972

⇒ \(\sqrt[4]{x^3+y^3+z^3+xyz}\) = \(\sqrt[4]{1215+81}\)
⇒ \(\sqrt[4]{1296}\) = 6

(CGL 2021 Pre)
solution:

36 = 32 + 2(ab + bc + ca) 
ab + bc + ca = \(4\over2\) = 2 
⇒ a3 + b3 + c3 - 3abc = (a + b + c) [(a + b + c)2 - 3(ab + bc + ca)] 
⇒ 189 - 3abc = 6[36 – 3 × 2]
⇒ 189 - 3abc = 180 
⇒ 3abc = 9
⇒ abc = 3

question:
If a2 + b2 + c2 = ab + bc + ca, then find the value of \({11a^4 + 13b^4 + 15c^4}\over{16a^2b^2 + 19b^2c^2+17c^2a^2}\). 
(CHSL 2023 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is Option 4 i.e. \(3\over4\).

The degrees of the numerator and denominator are the same. 
Put a = b = c = 1
\({11a^4 + 13b^4 + 15c^4}\over{16a^2b^2 + 19b^2c^2+17c^2a^2}\)
= \({11+13+15}\over{16+19+17}\) = \(39\over52\) = \(3\over4\)
